Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudRidge onboarding form + initial PO ask

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier this week. Attached is our completed onboarding form — it includes tax info, billing address, and the list of initial SKUs we expect to consume in month 1. Could you confirm how Redwood wants the PO referenced on invoices? We typically provide a single PO that covers the initial commitment and then issue amendments for line-item changes.

Quick notes:
- Initial estimated monthly spend: $55k (see line-item breakdown page 3)
- We need a PO number to start procurement routing on our end — can we get a provisional PO or ticket?
- Is a spend cap required to be encoded on the PO? If yes, please advise the format so our system accepts it.

Attachment: CloudRidge_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF)

Appreciate any quick confirmation.

Best,
Emily Park
Director, Procurement
CloudRidge Systems
E: epark@cloudridge.com
T: +1 (415) 555-0124

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Emily Park <epark@cloudridge.com>, procurement@cloudridge.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudRidge onboarding form + initial PO ask

Hi Emily — thanks for sending the form. Looping in Soojin (Procurement Ops) and Karthik (Finance) to help with PO issuance.

Short answers up front:
- We can provision a temporary PO ticket (internal reference) within 48 hours to unblock your procurement routing.
- Spend caps can be encoded in our PO metadata. Standard format we use is: "SPENDCAP:[amount]-[currency]-[expiry-date]" (e.g. SPENDCAP:55000-USD-2027-12-31). If you need a hard enforcement on spend, let us know and we can mark it as enforced.
- To avoid ambiguity for future amendments, please indicate which line items are fixed versus variable on page 3 — we marked a few ambiguous SKUs in red.

Action items:
1) Soojin — can you create a provisional PO ticket and attach draft PO for their review?
2) Karthik — please advise whether we should mark this as an "enforced" spend cap or advisory.

Emily — once Soojin drops the draft, we can loop in Laura in Finance for final ledger mapping.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Manager, Supplier Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: procurement@cloudridge.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: Emily Park <epark@cloudridge.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: RE: CloudRidge onboarding form + initial PO ask

Thanks Mateo — received. We'll accept the provisional ticket approach.

Two clarifications from our side:
- The $55k is our initial committed monthly total but some SKUs are usage-based; we'd prefer the spend cap be advisory to allow burst purchases if needed.
- Our procure-to-pay system requires the PO number in the invoice header and the SPENDCAP string in the PO notes field so our validator does a match.

We'll review the draft PO when you create it; Emily will follow up on the ambiguous SKUs by end of day.

Best,
CloudRidge Procurement Team

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com

Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: CloudRidge onboarding form + initial PO ask -- Draft PO and ledger notes

Forwarding draft PO and internal ledger reconciliation notes. See attached draft (filename below) and short summary of how we recommend mapping line items to our chargecodes. If this looks good to you, we'll issue PO #78912 as provisional.

Key reconciliation points:
- We mapped CloudRidge SKUs 100-104 to Redwood chargecode RC-INF-STD and split the estimated spend across two ledger lines to match month-start billing cycles.
- Line item 103 (variable usage) left as a separate line so amendments don't require a full PO re-issuance.
- Because CloudRidge asked for advisory spend cap, we set PO metadata: SPENDCAP:55000-USD-2027-12-31 (advisory). If you change to enforced, reply and we'll set enforcement flag and notify accounts payable.

Attachments: draft_PO_78912.pdf (PDF)

Laura — can you confirm the ledger mapping and whether the split across two ledger lines is OK for month-start invoicing?

Emily — once you confirm ambiguous SKUs, we'll finalize and send the PO number to your procure-to-pay system.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
